notes:
Asserts working → waiting when a tool call opens Copilot's confirmation prompt. The signal is entirely transcript-borne — Copilot writes permission.requested to events.jsonl WHILE it sits blocked (re-confirmed live 2026-08-03 on CLI 1.0.77: requestId f8eba6ed-…, kind=shell, hasWriteFileRedirection=true, held ~13s before teardown, with NO permission.completed) — so no hook and no :7837 pinning is involved.

KNOWN_FAILING — DAEMON BUG (live-refuted 2026-08-03): the daemon does NOT reach waiting. Everything up to the classifier is correct — the parser sets ParsedEvent.PermissionRequestIDs, the tailer folds it into openPermissions and derives tailer.SessionMetrics.TranscriptPermissionPending (tailer_metrics.go:475), and replayengine's Convert copies it into the domain metrics (replayengine/metrics.go:136). The break is one layer later: session.MergeMetrics → newMergedMetrics (core/domain/session/metrics.go:587) does not copy TranscriptPermissionPending, and the LIVE detector classifies against the POST-merge state.Metrics (metadata_enricher.go:103 then session_detector_activity.go:817), so the transcript_permission_prompt rule (state_classifier.go:151) sees false on every pass. The frozen events.jsonl for this cell therefore shows presession(ready) → real session(working) → nothing, with the permission line sitting in the transcript unobserved. The phases below deliberately assert the CORRECT behaviour: they are the regression contract, and known_failing comes off once the merge omission is fixed and the cell is re-recorded. REPLAY is immune (no MergeMetrics on that path), which is why the unit suites and replay-fixtures are green while live is broken.

BIRTH RE-ANCHORED 2026-08-03: the real session is born DIRECTLY into working, not ready. copilot creates session-state/<id>/ at launch with only workspace.yaml and writes events.jsonl only when the first prompt is sent, so at discovery the file already holds the open turn and buildNewSessionState classifies the birth against its own metrics. The transient proc-<PID> row is still born ready and remains the presession anchor; session_birth and turn_start are now ONE phase.

OBSERVATIONS assert `agent` only: the run terminates mid-turn with the prompt held, before any assistant.turn_end / session.usage_checkpoint / session.shutdown token block, so cost and tokens are legitimately zero here. Token/cost/model coverage belongs to 5-1_token-accounting and 5-2_model-identification.
